purpose: Teach: クリティカル/全会/総局/複写/扶桑社/スポークスマン/図版/中味

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、クリティカルな決断を即決された
lines.en: When you were founding the company, you made critical decisions with remarkable speed.
lines.style: Gentle, measured reflection. Voice carries quiet admiration. Slight pause before each memory, as if turning pages. Warm but not sentimental — the voice of someone recalling with clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは全会一致を重んじた経営をされた
lines.en: Yes. My father valued reaching consensus in everything we did.
lines.style: Respectful, grounded tone. Speaking as the son honouring his father's legacy. Steady cadence — each phrase deliberate. A touch of formal warmth, not distant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外総局を立ち上げる先見性をお持ちだった
lines.en: He had the foresight to establish our overseas operations before anyone else saw the need.
lines.style: Voice softens with genuine admiration. Slight lift on 「先見性」 — wonder at his father's vision. Unhurried pacing. The tone of someone reflecting on a man he deeply understood.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは契約書の複写を厳重に管理された
lines.en: Yes. He was meticulous about managing our contracts and proprietary information.
lines.style: Calm, factual respect. Not boasting — simply stating what was true. Steady breathing. A son recognizing his father's discipline as a strength.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、扶桑社系の編集者とも交流された
lines.en: He built relationships with editors across the industry, particularly at Fusosha.
lines.style: Voice carries gentle nostalgia. Slight wonder in the delivery — acknowledging a side of his father the world may not have fully seen. Warm, unhurried cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはスポークスマン的な役割もされた
lines.en: Yes. He took on the role of spokesman when the company needed him to.
lines.style: Measured and composed. Speaking of his father's public presence with understated pride. Even pacing — not theatrical, just clear. The voice of continuity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社史の図版にもこだわった
lines.en: Even the illustrations in our company history — he was particular about every detail.
lines.style: Slight smile in the voice. Warm recollection of a man who cared about the small things. Unhurried, with a gentle trailing emphasis on the care he took.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の中味で勝負された
lines.en: Yes. In the end, my father won by making sure our products spoke for themselves.
lines.style: Final statement, carrying the weight of learned wisdom. Calm, assured closing tone. A man who has come to understand what his father believed. Respectful pause at the end.
